using ll = long long;

const int MAX_N = 505;

ll MOD;
ll fact[MAX_N], invf[MAX_N];
ll C[MAX_N][MAX_N];

ll modPow(ll base, ll exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    if (exp == 1) return base % MOD;
    ll half = modPow(base, exp / 2);
    if (exp % 2 == 0) return (half * half) % MOD;
    return (base * half % MOD * half) % MOD;
}

ll modInverse(ll a) {
    return modPow(a, MOD - 2);
}

ll comb(int n, int k) {
    if (k > n || k < 0) return 0;
    return C[n][k];
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    cin >> MOD;

    fact[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < MAX_N; ++i) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i-1] * i) % MOD;
    }
    invf[MAX_N-1] = modInverse(fact[MAX_N-1]);
    for (int i = MAX_N-2; i >= 0; --i) {
        invf[i] = (invf[i+1] * (i+1)) % MOD;
    }

        for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    // dp1[i] = number of structures on i nodes
    // dp2[i] = sum of some weight over structures on i nodes
    vector<ll> dp1(n+1, 0), dp2(n+1, 0);
    dp1[0] = 1;
    dp2[0] = 0;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            ll term1 = (dp1[j] * dp1[i-1-j]) % MOD;
            term1 = (term1 * (i+1)) % MOD;
            term1 = (term1 * comb(i-1, j)) % MOD;
            dp1[i] = (dp1[i] + term1) % MOD;
            
            ll term2 = (dp1[j] * dp2[i-j-1] + dp2[j] * dp1[i-j-1]) % MOD;
            term2 = (term2 * (i+1)) % MOD;
            ll term3 = (dp1[j] * dp1[i-1-j]) % MOD;

            term3 = (term3 * weight) % MOD;

            term2 = (term2 * comb(i-1, j)) % MOD;
            dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + term2) % MOD;
        }
    }
    
    // dp3[i][j] = number of ways to build structure with i nodes and j marked edges
    // dp4[i][j] = sum of weights for such structures
    vector<vector<ll>> dp3(n+1, vector<ll>(m+1, 0));
    vector<vector<ll>> dp4(n+1, vector<ll>(m+1, 0));
